description: We are a team of 3 in 9th grade, and we are passionate about NASA and coding. Our project is a satellite launching game. It helps people understand the different parts of a satellite that helps it launch. It provides accurate NASA data for fuel, distance, budget, etc. It’s an interactive and engaging game that incorporates real life data. It contains different paths to go on, moon, mars, or outer space. Overall, this is an educational game that can help you learn new things in a fun way.
